description: This file defines a PHP class 'OAuthClientSearchFilterParams' that extends a base filter parameters class, specifying default sorting behavior for OAuth client search operations within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: OAuthClientSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) that encapsulates search filter parameters for OAuth clients, setting a default sort field upon instantiation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'oauthClient.id'.
